sources.articleTitle: Andreeva reaches WTA Finals semis, Svitolina fights back to beat Muchova
Sabalenka still hopeful of reaching WTA Finals last four despite defeat by Andreeva

headline: Mirra Andreeva Secures WTA Finals Semifinal Spot In Riyadh Debut
seoTitle: Andreeva Advances To WTA Finals Semifinals
metaDescription: Mirra Andreeva has qualified for the WTA Finals semifinals, while Aryna Sabalenka remains in contention despite a recent defeat in group play.
aiSummaryBullets: Mirra Andreeva advanced to the semifinal round of the WTA Finals tournament.
Aryna Sabalenka maintains hopes for a semifinal berth following her recent loss to Andreeva.
Elina Svitolina secured a victory against Karolina Muchova in the latest round of matches.
aiContextParagraph: The WTA Finals, currently being held in Riyadh, have entered a pivotal stage as players compete for semifinal positions. Recent tournament results show Mirra Andreeva successfully qualifying for the next round following her match against Aryna Sabalenka. Despite the loss, Sabalenka continues to pursue a spot in the final four of the competition. Additionally, the event featured a comeback victory for Elina Svitolina, who defeated Karolina Muchova. These matches are critical for determining the final standings within the tournament's group stage. The participants are currently navigating the pressure of the round-robin format as they aim to progress in the prestigious year-end championship. As the event progresses, spectators and analysts continue to track the performance of the remaining athletes to see who will ultimately advance to compete for the tournament title.
